rules.name: Surviving spouse joint return
rules.description: Surviving spouse filing a joint return does not need Form 1310; refund may be issued in both names.
rules.action: Issue the refund in both names without requiring Form 1310.
rules.source_quote: a Form 1310 is not required and the refund may be issued in both names

rules.name: Court-appointed representative documentation
rules.description: Court-appointed personal representative must submit Form 1310 and court certificate together; otherwise correspond to request it.

conditions.description: Claimant is a court-appointed personal representative

rules.action: Require Form 1310 and court certificate together; if court certificate missing, correspond to request documentation.
rules.source_quote:
both the Form 1310
and the court certificate must be received together

rules.name: Minus-X freeze suspend and release
rules.description: If a -X freeze will post and systemic refund criteria are met, suspend until freeze posts, then release.

conditions.description: -X freeze will be present after adjustment posts
Meets criteria for a systemic refund

rules.action: Suspend the case until the freeze has posted, then release the refund.
rules.source_quote:
suspend the case until the freeze has posted and
then release the refund

rules.name: Current year systemic release via TC 971 AC 807
rules.description: For a current year refund where TC 971 AC 807 applies, input it to release systemically.
rules.action: Input TC 971 AC 807 to release the refund systemically.
rules.source_quote:
input TC 971
AC 807 to release the refund systemically

rules.name: Prior year manual refund
rules.description: After the current year processing cycle ends, later cycles are prior year and require a manual refund.
rules.action: Issue a manual refund; perfect Form 1310 with the tax year.
rules.source_quote:
considered prior year and a manual refund is
required

rules.name: CII case note
rules.description: For CII cases, do not refile Form 1310 but leave a case note documenting the action.
rules.action: Do not refile Form 1310; leave a case note documenting the action taken.
rules.source_quote:
there is no need to refile the Form 1310, but leave a
case note
